name: Lasting power of attorney (LPA)
summary: How foreigners and PRs approach Singapore lasting power of attorney — Form 1 vs Form 2, certificate issuer roles, AMD adjacency, and when home-country POAs still fail local banks.
body:
A Singapore LPA lets you appoint donee(s) for personal welfare and/or property if you lose mental capacity. It is separate from a will and from CPF nomination. Foreign POAs often do not satisfy local banks or hospitals the way a registered Singapore LPA does.

## Decision points
- Form 1 (standard) vs Form 2 (custom drafting)
- Who can act as certificate issuer
- Property vs personal-welfare powers split
- Replacement donees and joint/several appointment
- Parallel advance medical directive (AMD) planning

PR and foreigner fee and eligibility details change — read OPG guidance before booking.

## How to choose
Use counsel familiar with cross-border assets when donees live overseas. Confirm witnessing and registration steps end-to-end; unsigned packs help nobody in an emergency. Pair LPA work with will refresh so executors and donees are not confused roles.

## Practical tip
Store the registration acknowledgement where your donee can find it, and tell them which bank branches hold your accounts. A perfect LPA still fails if nobody knows it exists.
